current.thesis: One active manuscript at thesis.md in staging. §§8.4, 8.8 and 11 analyse adversarial discovery, cross-profile event evidence and set-level atomicity. Pigeonhole specification claims reader-side AllOrNothing atomicity, but pinned v0.0.90 source shows sequential destination writes, independent persistence and no rollback of a successful prefix in the inspected failure path; thin-client v0.0.23 API/tests omit later-envelope failure with concurrent reader visibility. Actual reader visibility remains untested. katzenqt 0.0.2 separately gates conversation-log dispatch on a complete contiguous chain; this is application-level gating, not AllOrNothing or atomic storage. SRC-043 permits partial byte reconstruction, not authenticated logical-message acceptance. The endpoint acceptance sequence is standard protocol discipline, not a novel mechanism. The minimum evaluation is staged around three primary treatments: SRC-043-style multi-image set, single-file Dropbox object and raw Pigeonhole AllOrNothing; katzenqt is separate, Signal is a reference profile and OMR-family systems are retrieval comparators. Candidate C remains conditional; no controlled route result or rigorous counterexample establishes contribution. Thesis §1.1 now states representation flexibility: sender-selectable whole-object or segmented representation is optional and independent of carrier/transport, while logical identity, authenticated meaning, endpoint authority and acceptance semantics remain invariant.

thesis_argument.central_question: How can endpoint-controlled messaging preserve authenticated message semantics across replaceable, untrusted carriage routes, including image carriage, and what can route-specific evidence establish under defined observer models?
thesis_argument.proposition: Transport independence requires authenticated message semantics to remain under endpoint control across route-specific encapsulation and delivery, with explicit observer evidence.
thesis_argument.contributions: Responsibility-separated architecture; common route-comparison method (conditional on reproducible decision relevance); message-relationship/lifecycle analysis; claim-centred evidence discipline.
thesis_argument.route_synthesis: Image studies inform media transformation; SRC-043 already fragments/redundantly carries image fragments and permits partial byte recovery; Dropbox direct-invitation and view-only-link paths differ; Signal specs/client tags do not pin backend/account behaviour; Katzenpost source tags are pinned but no deployment is. Pigeonhole AllOrNothing spec claims are in tension with inspected sequential-write/no-rollback source path; reader visibility remains untested. OMR/StOMR/UnifOMR provide private retrieval/state/efficiency mechanisms, while SRC-052 demonstrates experimental service-scoped range completeness and retry. These do not establish global publication completeness or cross-carrier endpoint acceptance.
thesis_argument.prior_art_pressure: Prior-art comparison §10 now includes OMR/PerfOMR/SophOMR/InstantOMR/GOMR, StOMR, abstract-level UnifOMR, Oblivious Signaling, Remise, dead-drop and diffusion covert messaging, SRC-043, Echomix/Pigeonhole/katzenqt, Dropbox and Signal. Constituent mechanisms are established. The generic endpoint-acceptance sequence is standard protocol discipline; Candidate C is narrowed to a reproducible cross-route evaluation method requiring a decision-relevant result.
thesis_argument.limits: No deployed route comparison, implementation, experiment, formal proof, independent review or audit. Candidate C has not yet produced a decision-relevant result.

current.discovery_model: Discovery is decomposed into bootstrap/trust establishment, publication/indexing, candidate enumeration, recipient pertinence/retrieval authorisation, retrieval, extraction, endpoint validation and conversation association. Seven adversarial cases are integrated: bootstrap substitution, malicious publication, index equivocation/suppression, retrieval manipulation, cross-role collusion, retention/later disclosure and suppression/delay ambiguity. Endpoint-authenticated facts, service-reported events, observed metadata and inferred correlations remain distinct; index response does not prove completeness, and silence does not identify why a carrier is absent. No discovery mechanism, index-consistency mechanism or deletion guarantee is selected.
current.route_synthesis: The minimum controlled evaluation is staged, not full-factorial: three primary treatments (SRC-043-style multi-image set, single-file Dropbox object, raw Pigeonhole AllOrNothing); katzenqt is a separate application-gate observation; Signal is a protocol/service reference; OMR-family systems are retrieval comparators. First discriminating omissions are one redundant image copy missing/delayed, all copies of one fragment missing, and Pigeonhole E1 success followed by E2 delay/rejection while an already-authorised reader polls. No test has been run.
current.set_level_atomicity: Pigeonhole specification claims reader-side AllOrNothing atomicity; pinned v0.0.90 source shows sequential destination-envelope dispatch, independent persistence and no rollback of a successful prefix on the inspected failure path. Thin-client v0.0.23 API is sender-side only with no recipient ReadCap/reader commit control; tests cover success and first-envelope failure, not later failure with concurrent reader. katzenqt 0.0.2 separately persists received pieces and gates conversation-log dispatch on a terminal F plus contiguous decodable chain; this is app-level gating, not AllOrNothing or atomic storage. SRC-043 permits partial byte reconstruction; acceptance remains separate. No code/tests executed.
current.prior_art_pressure: Prior-art comparison §10 crosswalks OMR/GOMR and efficiency variants, StOMR stateful retrieval/OMR-KEM, UnifOMR OMR/PIR, Oblivious Signaling, Remise, dead-drop and diffusion covert messaging, SRC-043, Echomix/Pigeonhole/katzenqt, Dropbox and Signal. StOMR and UnifOMR primary papers are directly reviewed. StOMR's passive model, key-identity boundary, state recovery limits and 32-bit collision caveat are explicit. UnifOMR's malicious-detector integrity boundary and candidate-capacity accounting ambiguity are explicit. Component mechanisms are established; Candidate C remains a conditional reproducible cross-route method only.

defer: Create actual diagrams only after comparative argument and evidence stabilise; never use ASCII art.
External peer-review preparation until a coherent thesis candidate exists.
Implementation, platform experiments, extraction tests, steganalysis benchmarks, formal proof and security audit.
invariants: Image carriage is a required research comparison, not a mandatory runtime route.
Orchestration is optional; analyse service roles separately.
Protected object remains invariant unless explicit authenticated conversion is defined.
Package encapsulation is not endpoint authentication.
Endpoint-authenticated linkage and observer-inferred linkage are distinct.
Per-image concealment does not establish collection-level concealment.
GIF frames within one carrier are not separate image posts or logical messages.
Majority voting over bit errors does not establish missing-frame erasure tolerance.
No anonymity/security inference from carrier uniqueness, concealment or extra hops.
Preserve dissent, provenance, uncertainty and historical work; distinguish proposals from demonstrated properties.
Confidence is claim-specific, verifier-relative, evidence-bounded and time-sensitive; it is not a cryptographic property or semantic truth.
A valid fragment does not establish set completeness; a complete set does not establish conversation continuity.
Transport acceptance is not endpoint receipt, decryption, display, human reading or comprehension.
Prefer endpoint-local evidence and minimum necessary disclosure; no central confidence ledger or universal score by default.

Reconcile operational and substantive research documents; execute all unblocked work in priority order; ask only for user-only decisions/access/information.
project_instructions.context_limit: Preserve old chat; start a new chat inside the same Project; resume from live GitHub checkpoint and automatic summary.
project_instructions.status_label: Project metadata only; mention only when relevant, never as a conversational refrain.

automatic_reentry.behaviour: Every new or resumed chat in this Project reads START_HERE first, reconciles all actionable work across operational and substantive research documents against the task registry, executes unblocked work in priority order, and asks only for material user-only input; GitHub is authoritative.
automatic_reentry.context_limit: Preserve old chat; open a new chat inside this same Project; use automatic summary only as a clue and GitHub as authority.
automatic_reentry.external_installation: One-time manual installation of CHATGPT_PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md into Project settings is required; GitHub cannot modify ChatGPT Project settings or attach its files automatically.
automatic_reentry.status_label: Project metadata only; mention only when relevant.

sprint_priority: Resolve material research gaps and evidential weaknesses; blocked sources do not stall unrelated manuscript progress.
Maintain coherent terminology, arguments, citations and claim maturity.
Connect multi-message steganographic encapsulation and linkage to the wider architecture.
Update task records only when actual work changes their status.
Preserve active working scope with an in-session cache and baseline blob SHAs.

working_set.model: Assistant in-session cache of active GitHub files; not persistent local filesystem storage.
working_set.entry: Fetch live main and hydrate each relevant file once when it enters sprint scope; retain content, path and baseline blob SHA.
working_set.editing: Keep active files cached; track diffs against baseline; expand scope only for real dependencies.
working_set.conflict: If main moves, inspect changed paths and reconcile before writing; never silently overwrite concurrent work.
working_set.commit: One coherent multi-file commit is preferred. If Git Data ref-update is unavailable, use sequential Contents API updates with fetched blob SHAs and record the non-atomic limitation.
working_set.verification: Fetch resulting commit and every changed file; verify exact saved content and applicable checks.
working_set.release: Release cached files when workstream closes; rehydrate from GitHub next session.
working_set.project_instructions: Copy-ready Project Instructions now explicitly require in-session scope caching with baseline blob SHAs; no user local clone is required.

contribution_status: Candidate A remains an architectural organising principle, not a novelty claim. Candidate B (image-route advantage) remains conditional. Generic endpoint acceptance, authenticated manifests, completeness and freshness/replay handling are standard protocol obligations, not a novel mechanism. Candidate C remains a conditional reproducible cross-route evaluation method only; no controlled result or rigorous counterexample currently changes a route choice, invalidates an assurance claim or exposes a gap beyond prior art. The staged evaluation has three primary treatments: SRC-043-style multi-image set, single-file Dropbox object and raw Pigeonhole AllOrNothing; katzenqt is separate, Signal is reference-only, and OMR-family systems are retrieval comparators.

prior_art_crosswalk.status: Crosswalk §10 and decision-relevance test §10.3 reconciled with full StOMR and UnifOMR primary-paper reviews. Matrix minimality audit separates common faults from source-specific diagnostics and stages the three primary treatments; endpoint-acceptance mechanism novelty claim retired. Candidate C remains conditional, not established.
prior_art_crosswalk.judgement: Constituent mechanisms are established prior art. StOMR adds stateful private retrieval and OMR-KEM bootstrap but not human identity, global candidate-view completeness or multi-carrier acceptance; its 32-bit evaluated tags have a separate concrete collision-bound caveat. UnifOMR adds a two-round clue-detection/batch-PIR construction and concrete efficiency trade-offs, but privacy does not establish detector integrity or global candidate completeness; candidate-capacity accounting remains ambiguous. Only a reproducible cross-route method with decision-relevant output remains a possible contribution.
